nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set to the deployer in the constructor and mutable via setNewOwner.
Registration price in wei; initialized to 0.069 ether and mutable via setNewRegistrationPrice.
Dynamic array holding every address that has ever registered as a customer.
Mapping from address to Customer struct (isPaid flag and expirationDate); tracks subscription state.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender and registrationFee = 0.069 ether.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts on any unknown calldata.
View function returning addressList.length, i.e. the number of registered customers.
Payable registration entry point; validates msg.value and existing subscription, pushes msg.sender into addressList and writes expirationDate using block.timestamp.
View helper comparing block.timestamp against a user's expirationDate to report expiry.
onlyOwner admin function that reassigns the owner state variable.
onlyOwner admin function that updates the registrationFee state variable.
onlyOwner admin function looping over an address array and clearing isPaid for expired users.
onlyOwner admin function transferring the whole contract balance to the owner address.
onlyOwner admin function transferring a caller specified amount to an arbitrary recipient address.
onlyOwner admin function that marks an arbitrary address as paid without payment.
External caller address (msg.sender) used for ownership, registration keys and access checks.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp used to derive subscription expiration dates and expiry checks.
payable(owner).transfer(address(this).balance) external value transfer inside withdrawToOwner.
payable(_recipient).transfer(_amount) external value transfer to an arbitrary address inside withdrawToAddress.
addressList.push(msg.sender) unbounded array growth inside register.
block.timestamp + 365 days arithmetic used to compute the subscription expirationDate.
_address parameter of userPastExpiration used as the mapping lookup key.
_newOwner parameter of setNewOwner; new owner address written to storage.
_newFee parameter of setNewRegistrationPrice; new registration price written to storage.
_address array parameter of resetUserPaidStatus iterated to reset payment flags.
_recipient parameter of withdrawToAddress; destination of the value transfer.
_amount parameter of withdrawToAddress; value sent in the transfer.
_address parameter of giveAccountAway; account granted free paid status.
Loop counter i used in resetUserPaidStatus to iterate the address array.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the constructor to initialise ownership.
Constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
register() reads msg.sender as the subscriber key.
register() writes isPaid and expirationDate for UserRegistion[msg.sender].
register() appends the new subscriber to addressList.
msg.sender is the element pushed into the addressList array.
register() reads registrationFee to validate that msg.value covers the required price.
register() uses block.timestamp to decide and set expiration dates, making behaviour miner dependent.
userPastExpiration compares block.timestamp with the stored expirationDate.
register() executes block.timestamp + 365 days to derive the expiration date.
block.timestamp is the operand of the timestamp arithmetic operation.
Timestamp arithmetic result is stored into UserRegistion.expirationDate.
register() invokes the addressList.push operation for new customers.
The push operation mutates the addressList state variable.
userPastExpiration reads UserRegistion[_address].expirationDate.
resetUserPaidStatus calls the userPastExpiration helper inside its loop.
resetUserPaidStatus writes UserRegistion[_address[i]].isPaid = false.
giveAccountAway writes isPaid = true for an arbitrary address without payment.
setNewOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
setNewRegistrationPrice overwrites the registrationFee state variable.
getCustomerCount reads addressList.length.
withdrawToOwner reads the owner address as the transfer destination.
withdrawToOwner performs the payable(owner).transfer external value transfer.
withdrawToAddress performs the payable(_recipient).transfer external value transfer.
_recipient is the destination address of the external transfer.
_amount is the value forwarded by the external transfer.
_recipient is the parameter consumed by withdrawToAddress.
_amount is the parameter consumed by withdrawToAddress.
_address parameter is the lookup key used by userPastExpiration.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by setNewOwner.
_newFee parameter is consumed by setNewRegistrationPrice.
_address array parameter is iterated by resetUserPaidStatus.
_address parameter is consumed by giveAccountAway.
Loop counter i drives the iteration in resetUserPaidStatus.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before setNewOwner executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before setNewRegistrationPrice executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before resetUserPaidStatus executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before withdrawToOwner executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before withdrawToAddress executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before giveAccountAway executes.
External value transfer to owner could call back into withdrawToOwner, but transfer forwards only 2300 gas so reentrancy is not feasible.
External value transfer to _recipient could call back into withdrawToAddress, but transfer forwards only 2300 gas so reentrancy is not feasible.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter is only a lookup key for userPastExpiration and has no standalone semantic identity.
_newOwner is directly written into the owner state variable by setNewOwner.
_newFee is directly written into the registrationFee state variable by setNewRegistrationPrice.
The address array parameter only exists to drive the reset loop inside resetUserPaidStatus.
_recipient is the destination of the value transfer performed inside withdrawToAddress.
_amount is the value forwarded by the transfer performed inside withdrawToAddress.
_address is directly used as the mapping key written by giveAccountAway.
The loop counter i is a purely local artefact of the resetUserPaidStatus iteration.
